dialect.detail: GnuCOBOL with htmlpp preprocessor directives ($set preprocess(htmlpp)), free source format, used in a Brazilian ERP/retail system (JMA ORCA-style or similar Brazilian CGI-COBOL framework). Uses EXEC HTML blocks for web output.

purpose.domain_detail: Product similarity/substitution registration in a Brazilian retail/merchandise management system. Manages pairs of similar/substitute products (Mercadoria x Similar).
purpose.summary: This program implements a web-based CGI COBOL screen for registering product similarity (Cadastro de Similaridade). It allows users to link two merchandise items as similar/substitutable, with validation, save, and delete operations. The UI is rendered via embedded HTML using an htmlpp preprocessor.

notable_features: EXEC HTML blocks (htmlpp preprocessor for CGI web output)
IS EXTERNAL-FORM clause for CGI input
IDENTIFIED BY clause for HTML form field binding
11 COPY statements for modular copybook structure
JavaScript embedded in EXEC HTML for client-side validation
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
verdict.notes: Source is truncated at 16000 chars but all four divisions are present and the structure is clear. The dialect is likely GnuCOBOL with a custom htmlpp preprocessor used in a Brazilian CGI-based ERP/retail system. The 'online-cics' program_type is used loosely here — this is actually a CGI web program, not CICS, but no better enum value exists. The EXEC HTML construct is not standard COBOL; it is a vendor/framework extension.
